option_relations.rationale: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) is a cause of cystoid macular edema, but the leaf is the edema itself, not the cause. Thus, there is no direct relation as defined.
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema is a broader condition that includes cystoid macular edema as a component.
